svg.title: Хип-траст одной ногой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Single-leg hip thrust. True oblique side view. Shoulder blades remain supported against front edge of low padded bench, pelvis beyond bench, one knee bent with working foot flat on floor and free leg held extended forward in midair. START hips down low, FINISH hips rise to align shoulders–pelvis–working knee, with only the same working foot bearing weight. Free shoe clearly off ground in both poses, no weight. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
